nordic_runes.title: 🎚️  **Ancient Aryan Science - Old Germanic Runes**
nordic_runes.description: Approach and illuminate your destiny viz ancient Germanic knowledge. Ze Elder Futhark runes speak viz truth and power, showing ze path for soldiers and officers alike.
nordic_runes.available_readings:
- **Single Rune**(quick cast): Each rune represents a cosmic concept, a natural force or an aspect of human existence.
 - **Three Runes**(past/present/future): Ze three rune cast follows ze Germanic pattern of temporal understanding: 'Urðr' (past/voven destiny), 'Verðandi' (present/vat is being), and 'Skuld' (future/vat must be).
 - **Five Runes in Cross** : Ze five rune cross is an advanced divination technique zat maps human reality in five fundamental dimensions, similar to ze five cardinal points of ze Germanic magical compass.
 - **Seven Runes Runic Cross**: Ze seven runic cross is ze most advanced Germanic divination technique, known as 'Yggdrasil Cross' for its connection viz ze world tree
nordic_runes.how_to_use:
**How to use:**
 1. Choose ze reading type in ze selector below.
 2. Enter your question in ze modal zat vill appear.
 3. You vill receive your personalized reading by private message viz Hans's interpretation.

nordic_runes.help_content:
🔮 **HANS ZE RUNE SEER** 🔮

**Vhat are Germanic Runes?**
ACHTUNG! Ze Elder Futhark runes are ze ancient symbols of ze northern warriors, used by Germans to see ze future and receive guidance from ze gods!

**Available Casts:**
• **Single Rune** - Quick guidance for specific questions
• **Three Runes** - Past, Present, Future of ze warrior
• **Five Cross** - Complete battle analysis

**How to use?:**
• Use ze commands: `!runes cast [type] <question>`!
• Example: `!runes cast single vhat should I do today?`!

**Ze 24 Elder Futhark Runes:**
Fehu • Uruz • Thurisaz • Ansuz • Raidho • Kenaz • Gebo • Wunjo
Hagalaz • Nauthiz • Isa • Jera • Eiwaz • Perthro • Algiz • Sowilo
Tiwaz • Berkano • Ehwaz • Mannaz • Laguz • Ingwaz • Dagaz • Othala

Each rune carries ancient visdom for your warrior path!
nordic_runes.types_content:
🔮 **ANCIENT RUNE CAST TYPES** 🔮

**single** - Single Rune
└ Quick guidance for a specific question - Uses 1 rune

**three** - Three Runes
└ Past, Present, Future reading - Uses 3 runes

**cross** - Five Cross
└ Complete situation analysis - Uses 5 runes

**runic_cross** - Runic Cross
└ Deep seven rune reading for spiritual guidance - Uses 7 runes

**Usage Examples:**
`!runes cast single vhat should I do today?`
`!runes cast three vait awaits me in ze future?`
`!runes cast cross Help me understand my current situation`

ACHTUNG! Choose your cast and ask ze ancient runes!
